Container.Name: bookhoard
Container.Overview: Bookhoard – a self-hosted e-book library with a pleasant web UI (light/dark theme, bookshelves, tags). Publishes the library as an OPDS catalog for KOReader (Kobo, PocketBook, Kindle, Android), fetches Polish metadata and covers from lubimyczytac.pl, and can search Anna's Archive and download books straight into the library.[br][br] [b]After install:[/b] open the WebUI and sign in with APP_USER / APP_PASSWORD. In KOReader add the OPDS catalog http://[UNRAID-IP]:8080/opds/ with the same login.[br] Drop files into the Ingest folder (e.g. over SMB) to import them automatically.

Config.Name: WebUI / OPDS port
Config.Description: Web interface and the KOReader OPDS catalog (/opds/).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database and cover cache.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Your book library. Books are stored as Author/Title/Title - Author.epub. Existing files here are imported on start.

Config.Name: Ingest folder
Config.Description: Drop e-book files here to import them; they are moved into the Library. Must NOT be inside the Library folder.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Login for the web UI and KOReader OPDS catalog.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Login password. Leaving it empty disables authentication – only do that on a trusted network.

Config.Name: Anna's Archive secret key
Config.Description: Your membership secret key from the Anna's Archive account page (the /account page on the current Anna's Archive domain). Enables fast, reliable downloads; without it only LibGen mirrors are used.

Config.Name: Anna's Archive mirrors
Config.Description: Comma-separated mirror URLs, tried in order. Domains change often – check the current ones on the Anna's Archive Wikipedia page.

Config.Name: Default search language
Config.Description: Default language filter on the Discover page (pl, en, de, ... or empty for any).

Config.Name: Default search format
Config.Description: Default format filter on the Discover page (epub, mobi, azw3, fb2, pdf or empty).

Config.Name: Search source
Config.Description: Where Discover searches by default: auto (Anna's Archive, falling back to LibGen), libgen, or annas.

Config.Name: LibGen mirrors
Config.Description: LibGen mirrors for search and downloads (matched by MD5), comma-separated, tried in order.

Config.Name: Outbound proxy
Config.Description: Optional HTTP proxy for all scraping and downloads, e.g. a gluetun/VPN container: http://192.168.1.10:8888

Config.Name: Auto-match on lubimyczytac.pl
Config.Description: Fetch metadata and covers from lubimyczytac.pl for newly imported books (true/false).

Config.Name: Tags from lubimyczytac
Config.Description: categories = only genres (fantasy, science fiction, literatura piękna…); all = genres plus readers' free-form tags.

Config.Name: Auto-match threshold
Config.Description: How confident (0-1) an automatic match must be before it is applied.

Config.Name: lubimyczytac request delay
Config.Description: Seconds between requests to lubimyczytac.pl.

Config.Name: Write metadata into EPUBs
Config.Description: Also change the EPUB/KEPUB files themselves when metadata is edited or matched (true/false). Off by default: Bookhoard keeps metadata in its own database and your files stay untouched.

Config.Name: App name
Config.Description: Name shown in the UI and in KOReader.

Config.Name: Ingest scan interval
Config.Description: Seconds between scans of the Ingest folder.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for new files.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.
